services.title: Building Repairs
services.metaDescription: Residential and commercial building repairs across Auckland, including carpentry, doors, windows, interiors and rental property maintenance.
services.intro: Practical residential and commercial repairs, planned around the property and the work required. ANDRO helps keep buildings functional and cared for, from small repairs through to minor refurbishment.
services.description: We assess the repair needs, agree a clear scope and carry out considered work with attention to the details. For restricted building work or specialist trades, appropriately licensed subcontractors may be engaged where required.

services.title: Exterior Upkeep
services.seoTitle: Exterior Property Maintenance in Auckland | ANDRO
services.metaDescription: Auckland exterior property maintenance, including cladding, trim, deck and fence repairs, cleaning and general improvements.
services.intro: Thoughtful exterior upkeep helps protect and maintain the places people live and work. We provide practical maintenance and improvements tailored to each property.
services.description: From timber repairs to exterior cleaning and preparation, we can help address visible wear and routine maintenance needs. The scope is agreed before work begins; specialist or restricted work is referred to appropriately licensed subcontractors where required.
items: Exterior painting preparation and painting coordination

services.title: Ongoing Property Care
services.seoTitle: Ongoing Property Maintenance in Auckland | ANDRO
services.metaDescription: Scheduled and preventative residential and commercial property maintenance for Auckland owners, landlords and property managers.
services.intro: A dependable maintenance plan can help property owners stay ahead of repairs. ANDRO provides practical ongoing care for residential and commercial properties across Auckland.
services.description: We can support scheduled maintenance, respond to property manager requests and coordinate agreed repairs. Maintenance is scoped to the property and priorities; specialist work and restricted building work may require appropriately licensed subcontractors.
